BR_Community_Water_Coordination_Room.text: Community water-coordination room — practical municipal tables, printed basin maps, physical ledgers, rugged radios, pump telemetry and ordinary maintained public infrastructure.

BR_Tethergrid_Mobile_Command_Platform.text: Tethergrid mobile command platform — immaculate graphite corporate operations interior with brushed alloy, tactile/glass controls, restrained cyan/amber status light, configurable command, analysis and interception workstations, and Mojave terrain beyond.

BR_Launch_Shop_Control_Cabin.text: Launch-Shop mobile control cabin — compact maintained retro-aerospace controls, analog gauges, physical switches, restrained digital readouts and bright Mojave light through the windows.

BR_Launch_Shop_Tanker_Workshop.text: Mobile Launch-Shop tanker workshop — maintained retro-industrial aerospace work bay inside the moving field vehicle, with painted metal, tactile analog-digital instruments, organized tools, padded work surfaces, practical task lighting and controlled localized wear; usable parked or underway.

BR_Mojave_Field_Launch_Site.text: Mojave field launch site — maintained hand-built aerospace hardware, compact support equipment, practical rigging, hard desert light and broad unobstructed sky.

BR_Community_Wellhead_Pump_Yard.text: Community wellhead and pump yard — maintained water hardware, sun-bleached concrete, shade structure, visible mechanical gauges, clear piping state and hard Mojave daylight.

BR_Launch_Shop_Exterior_Work_Deck.text: Launch-Shop exterior work deck — maintained tanker/flatbed structure, organized field hardware, hard Mojave sun and broad desert horizon.

BR_Mojave_Limestone_Ridge.text: Mojave limestone ridge — pale fractured stone, bright high-desert sun, long sightlines, sparse scrub and the launch corridor below.

BR_Public_Sky_Ground_Relay_Site.text: Public Sky ground-relay site — maintained mast, compact solar power, tactile control box, physical status lamps and open Mojave terrain with line-of-sight to neighboring ridges.

BR_Remote_Propulsion_Test_Stand.text: Remote propulsion test stand — reinforced concrete, clear exclusion zone, instrumented test article, shielded observation position and bright open desert.

BR_Decommissioned_Hydroelectric_Service_.text: Decommissioned hydroelectric service gallery — massive concrete structure, damp cool air, old mechanical governors, steel railings, moss at exposed spillway edges and safe portable work lighting.

BR_Sky_Piercer_Sandstorm_Route.text: Mobile Sky-Piercer launch route inside a Mojave sandstorm — low visibility, disciplined vehicle lighting, secured hardware, blowing grit and intermittent amber desert light.

BR_Decommissioned_Industrial_Furnace_Com.text: Decommissioned Mojave industrial furnace complex — tall refractory-lined furnace bays with intact and damaged ceramic panels, expansion joints and retainers, tagged hazardous-material and disposal areas, portable ventilation and salvage staging, exposed service roads, and hard desert light outside.

BR_Community_Water_Distribution_Point.text: Community water distribution point — shaded public fill taps and standpipes, household containers and small tanks, posted allocation notices, simple physical meters, volunteer attendants, utility vehicles and ordinary residents moving through the site under hard Mojave light.

BR_Community_Clinic_Service_Yard.text: Community clinic service yard — modest maintained clinic buildings, medicine refrigeration and temperature monitoring, shaded loading area, water storage and transfer connections, practical utility vehicles and staff working in severe high-desert conditions.

BR_Community_Water_Truck_Fill_Yard.text: Community water-truck fill yard — municipal standpipe and hose manifold, ordinary water-hauling and maintenance trucks, paper dispatch board, rugged radios, service tools, drivers and utility workers under open Mojave sun.
